definitions.gloss: recognition, visual memory, remembrance of having seen
definitions.explanation: The feeling or memory of having seen something or someone before. Almost always used with ある or ない to express whether one recognizes something.

examples.japanese: この{顔|かお}には{見覚|みおぼ}えがある。
{見覚|みおぼ}えのない{番号|ばんごう}から{電話|でんわ}がかかってきた。
examples.english: I got a call from a number I didn't recognize.

examples.japanese: この{場所|ばしょ}は{見覚|みおぼ}えがあるけど、いつ{来|き}たか{思|おも}い{出|だ}せない。
examples.english: I recognize this place, but I can't remember when I came here.

notes:
USAGE:
{見覚|みおぼ}え is almost always paired with がある (to have) or がない (to not have). The pattern {見覚|みおぼ}えのある／ない + noun is also very common as a modifier. Compare with {聞|き}き{覚|おぼ}え (recognition of something heard).

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {見覚|みおぼ}えがある: to recognize (having seen before)
- {見覚|みおぼ}えがない: to not recognize
- {見覚|みおぼ}えのある{顔|かお}: a face one recognizes
- {見覚|みおぼ}えのない{人|ひと}: a person one doesn't recognize
